name: InputEngine::StartLength

name: InputEngine::NextMatch
note: Huffman-decodes words of the current length (8-bit lookahead table, then bit-by-bit trie walk), at most 2000 per call, testing each against the MatchEngineSet

name: MatchEngineSet::EvalLogic
note: boolean VM over the logic bytecode: 1=OR 2=AND 3=END 4=open paren 5=close paren, bit 0x08=NOT. mode 0 = precomputed flags, 1 = length pre-check (NOT is skipped), 2 = match the word. The 0x412000 address in your notes is this function in TEA.exe

name: MatchEngine::CompilePattern
note: compiles "[template][;anagram]" into 0xf9 <minLen> <extra> ... 0xfc; for an anagram part emits 0xf4 <numLetters> <minCount:4> then CompileAnagram's code; recursive through CompileTemplate for sub-patterns

name: MatchEngine::CompileTemplate
note: compiles the template part: letters and '.'/'?' into a 0xf0 group, choice lists [..] / [^..] and digit variables into a 0xf1 group, punctuation 0xfe/0xff, '*' as 0xf2 wildcard, (..) sub-patterns via CompilePattern; returns the minimum letter count or -1 with the status set

name: MatchEngine::CompileAnagram
note: compiles the anagram part in stages: sub-patterns (0xfa count pool-index), choice lists (0xf7 count pool-index), letter variables (0xf8 + ten counts), then named letters as singles (0xf5) or multiples (0xf6); returns the letter count or -1 with the status set

name: MatchEngine::Compile
note: compiles one leaf pattern: appends ')' and runs CompilePattern, records min/max length, removes trailing ' ' punctuation pairs, picks the matcher (MatchFixedTemplate / MatchDistinctAnagram / MatchMultiAnagram when the code is a single stage, else MatchGeneral) and fills the punctuation table

name: MatchEngine::IsValid
note: returns the int at +0x1020; MatchEngineSet::Compile treats 0 as a compile failure

name: MatchEngine::GetStatus
note: returns the status byte at +0x1024

name: MatchEngine::MatchEngine
note: constructor: Pattern pool, empty bytecode string, shortest=1, longest=100, matcher=MatchGeneral

name: MatchEngine::SetShortest
note: clamps to 1..100 and stores at +0x1134

name: MatchEngine::SetLongest
note: clamps to 1..100 and stores at +0x1138

name: MatchEngine::SetWordLength
note: stores the candidate length (+0x113c) and the slack over the template minimum (+0x1140)

name: MatchEngine::MatchWord

name: MatchEngine::FormatBalance

name: MatchEngine::MatchDistinctAnagram

name: MatchEngine::MatchMultiAnagram
note: fast path for anagrams with repeated letters. Entry checked; body not read

name: MatchEngine::RunTemplateVM
note: template interpreter: fixed letters (0xf0), letter/choice/variable groups (0xf1), punctuation (0xfe/0xff), wildcards (0xf2/0xf3), sub-patterns (0xf9..0xfb); backtracks and restores variable bindings on failure

name: MatchEngine::AnagramSingleLetters
note: anagram opcode 0xf5 operand walker: <count> <letter...>

name: MatchEngine::AnagramMultiLetters
note: anagram opcode 0xf6: (multiplicity, letter) pairs checked against the letter histogram with an omission budget

name: MatchEngine::AnagramChoiceLists
note: anagram opcode 0xf7 solver. Entry checked; body not read

name: MatchEngine::AnagramChoiceListsOp

name: MatchEngine::AnagramVariables
note: anagram opcode 0xf8: tries each unclaimed letter (not bound to another variable) for each free variable in turn, recursing; then runs the next stage

name: MatchEngine::AnagramSubPattern
note: anagram opcodes 0xfa/0xfb: places a sub-pattern over each run of unclaimed letters (claimed letters carry bit 7), longest first, and continues with the rest of the anagram

name: MatchEngine::RunAnagramVM
note: anagram bytecode interpreter. Entry checked; body not read

name: MatchEngine::ComputeBalance
